description: Fiets Hoofdnetwerk is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Gemeente Utrecht. Hoofdnetwerk fiets uit Mobiliteitsplan 2040 Aantal objecten 13.000+ Attributen - BRIDGE (String) - CODE (BigDecimal) - FCLASS (String) - FIETSROUTE (String) - GEOM (Geometry) - ID (BigDecimal) - LAAGNAAM (String) - LAYER (String) - LENGTE (BigDecimal) - MAXSPEED (BigDecimal) - NAME (String) - ONEWAY (String) - OSMID (String) - REF (String) - TUNNEL (String) KaartViewer ... Coverage: Gemeente Utrecht. The portal files it under the publisher Gemeente Utrecht. Its tags are KV_RUIMTE_OPENBAAR GeoServer, KaartViewer Utrecht, geoserver, open, open data. It offers 7 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GPKG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/SHP. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
